LinearizedModel.description:
First-order perturbation model about x0/u0, in declared coordinate order.

A/B are continuous derivatives or discrete transition Jacobians according
to time_domain. drift is f(x0,u0) (continuous) or f(x0,u0)-x0 (discrete).
Omitted drift asserts an equilibrium; linearization never implies it.

Omitted drift asserts an equilibrium; linearization never implies it.

LinearizedModel.description:
First-order perturbation model about x0/u0, in declared coordinate order.

A/B are continuous derivatives or discrete transition Jacobians according
to time_domain. drift is f(x0,u0) (continuous) or f(x0,u0)-x0 (discrete).
Omitted drift asserts an equilibrium; linearization never implies it.
LinearizedModel.title: LinearizedModel

LinearizedModel.description:
First-order perturbation model about x0/u0, in declared coordinate order.

A/B are continuous derivatives or discrete transition Jacobians according
to time_domain. drift is f(x0,u0) (continuous) or f(x0,u0)-x0 (discrete).
Omitted drift asserts an equilibrium; linearization never implies it.
LinearizedModel.title: LinearizedModel

What is NOT supported: any claim of target reach within the stated limits, and any distinct "reach" judgment at all — no reach criterion, tolerance or reach verdict field exists in the inspected source, so reach success is unknown here rather than measured-failed. Also unsupported: any generalization from the one-step agreement statistics (aligned_count 35, max 0.006041094970688899 m) to trajectory-level tracking, because the record itself scopes them to first-step matches with "no future-plan replay comparison". Purely descriptive coincidences/limitations to carry alongside, without causal reading: sampled max_error equals the terminal error exactly (so the windowed maximum carries no independent information beyond the ending value in what is recorded), and that 0.05 s window aggregate is reported while simulated_duration_s is 0.35 and control_period_s is 0.01. Internal tension worth flagging: converged_updates=0 with deadline_misses=35 (one per control update) and accepted_noninitialization_plans=0 while initialization_selected=35, yet the run is still recorded complete and valid — I do not diagnose a dominant cause for these facts. Scope limits: the authorized directory contained exactly one entry, this artifact, which I read in full across its 36 root fields; the evaluation, simulation, configuration, report and prediction-evidence artifacts referenced inside it were not in scope and were not read, so the criteria definitions behind passed, task_accepted and the plan counters are unknown. messages.content: Investigate only the scoped evidence. All advertised functions accept their business fields directly, with no arguments/reason/tool_version wrapper. Exactly one native call per turn. Read additional pages with evidence_read; finish with investigation_return. Facts and counterevidence require exact visible source values, one JSON Pointer each, and original source identity. Principal must evaluate support independently and may accept supported portions, defer or reject; suggestions authorize no computation. Principal dispositions use catalog handles and optional extraction-only relative projections. supporting_facts must come from that report; additional_support explicitly marks principal supplemental facts. scope is separate. Choose claims, dispositions and explanations yourself; valid handles do not prove reasoning. No need to repeat raw values, identities or inspection declarations. All report bodies, counterevidence and unknowns remain available. Source and report inspections are checked independently.
